newsitem.title: USA: Sioux Falls cattle steady/off $0.50 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Sioux Falls cattle steady/off $0.50 - USDA.

text.p: USDA said slaughter steers and heifers were moderately active. Both classes traded steady to $0.50 lower than last Wednesday.
Steers - high select and choice 2-3 1200-1350 lbs 67.00- 68.50. Select and choice 2-3 1100-1300 lbs 65.50-67.00. Select 1-2 63.00-65.50.
Heifers - high select and choice 2-3 1050-1250 lbs 66.00-68.00. Select and choice 2-3 950-1100 lbs 63.50-66.00. Select 1-2 62.00-63.50.
